facts.fact: 迟到的戒断：回程车上终于来——needling and hammer-like；阳光成 migraine lens flare；重过任何病——藏住不让 David 见（怕被当 undependable junkie 丢路边）；死守副驾、exist from one moment to the next
facts.anchor: Here was withdrawal, needling and hammer-like, come to collect.

facts.fact: 一周之差：上周首程=人生展开；本周 wrecked、sapped of all curiosity——「旅行没什么 special：整个国家都是 Lubbock——同样的 drive-thrus/加油站/3D 打印建筑/快餐广告牌重复千英里——如皮肤上凸起的 goose pimples、百万块未愈的塑料淤青」

双杀（克制）：Emily 军规从州界回响（You can't hesitate）；大堂 Rusty 问话+伸手桌下——热头上当是枪、依令开枪：一发干净穿颅（brief rush of pride；David 微笑点头）；厨房第二目标=举着 Jules 旧 Walmart 枪、几秒后要杀 Bethany 的 tech douche——先开枪、尸体 crumple 进碎玻璃与芥末豌豆池；David 已冲向 Bethany——「There it was again. That old psycho glint…now fixed squarely on Bethany Peters.」；逃向停车场时瞥第一具尸体：Rusty 手里握的真正东西=独立塑封的 sucking candies 小碟——不是枪
facts.anchor: It wasn’t a gun. It was a little dish of sucking candies

facts.fact: 现在时停车场（克制）：第三目标 Douglas（seen our plates）拖出跪地；David 砸碎 Bethany 手机、注射器扎臂——「short out the tracking device they've been using to monitor you」；Douglas 求饶（girlfriend+her kid、cool uncle figure、equivocating）；Bethany 挡枪口「He's an idiot. But he doesn't deserve to die.」——David 眼中 psycho glint 再现（为她的违令骄傲=更证明她是 the one）——Jules 羞怒（忆 Turbo Putt 录 vlog 出 mush 的自伤冲动、无刀改向外）——「I killed two people just now…I am not afraid to make you the third.」；David 斥「Just take him with us. But do it quickly」
facts.anchor: This will short out the tracking device

facts.fact: 逃亡心绪：四亡命徒出库（蹭护栏 ember、国会大道三倍速）；后视镜偷瞄 Bethany——怒中泛起 strange relief：想她了；「她 the special one——不是 David/Emily/更不是自己；Jules hates Bethany Peters, but let's be real—they're sort of in love with her, too.」；国会大厦与 Austin 远去
facts.anchor: they’re sort of in love with her, too.
